data.paraphrase: For every function f from the natural numbers to the integers, if for every n greater than 0, f(n) is equal to the sum of the factorials from 1 to n, then there exist polynomials P and Q such that for every n greater than or equal to 1, f(n + 2) is equal to P evaluated at n multiplied by f(n + 1) plus Q evaluated at n multiplied by f(n).
